tagline: One recording. Four documents ready to review.

transcript.speaker: Caregiver
transcript.text: Good morning Eleanor. How have you been feeling since our last visit?

transcript.speaker: Eleanor
transcript.text: A little unsteady getting out of the chair, but the mornings are better when someone helps with breakfast.

transcript.speaker: Caregiver
transcript.text: We will keep meal prep on the plan, and I want to check your blood pressure before we finish.

transcript.speaker: Eleanor
transcript.text: My daughter wants someone here three mornings a week, and she asked about a written agreement.

note.subjective: Client reports mild morning unsteadiness transferring from chair. Daughter requesting three morning visits per week with a written service agreement.
note.objective: Assisted with bathing and dressing. Prepared breakfast. Reminded client of morning medications. Blood pressure checked and within usual range for this client.
note.assessment: Needs ongoing ADL support and meal assistance. Stable for home care with caregiver present during morning routine.
note.plan: Continue three mornings weekly. Include personal care, meal prep, medication reminders, and companionship. Provide service agreement for family review.

contract.title: Home Care Service Agreement - Eleanor Whitfield
contract.terms: Services begin after signed agreement. Schedule is Monday, Wednesday, and Friday mornings. Family may cancel with 48 hours notice.
